# `credentials` pack

<!-- Generated by `REDACT_BLESS=1 cargo test` from the code. Do not edit by hand. -->

Tokens, keys and passwords: JWTs, bearer tokens, common vendor key shapes, private key blocks, passwords in URLs, values named as secrets, and environment dump values

| Rule | Hides as | What it finds | Hidden everywhere after |
| :- | :- | :- | :- |
| `jwt` | `[JWT-…]` | A JSON Web Token (header.payload.signature), e.g. an Azure access token |  |
| `bearer` | `[TOKEN-…]` | The token after Bearer in an Authorization header |  |
| `github-token` | `[TOKEN-…]` | GitHub personal, OAuth, app and fine-grained tokens |  |
| `ai-key` | `[API-KEY-…]` | Anthropic and OpenAI API keys |  |
| `aws-key` | `[API-KEY-…]` | AWS access key IDs |  |
| `vendor-key` | `[API-KEY-…]` | Slack, Stripe and Google API keys |  |
| `azure-storage-key` | `[STORAGE-KEY-…]` | AccountKey= and SharedAccessKey= in Azure connection strings |  |
| `azure-sas` | `[SAS-SIG-…]` | The signature of an Azure SAS URL |  |
| `entra-client-secret` | `[CLIENT-SECRET-…]` | An Entra ID (Azure AD) app client secret |  |
| `private-key` | `[PRIVATE-KEY-…]` | A PEM private key block |  |
| `url-password` | `[PASSWORD-…]` | The password in scheme://user:password@host |  |
| `named-secret-quoted` | `[SECRET-…]` | A double-quoted value of TOKEN, "password", client_secret and other names that say secret | when it reads as a name |
| `named-secret-single-quoted` | `[SECRET-…]` | A single-quoted value of a name that says secret | when it reads as a name |
| `named-secret` | `[SECRET-…]` | An unquoted value of TOKEN=, password:, client_secret: and other names that say secret, to the end of the line (YAML values may hold spaces) | when it reads as a name |
| `env-dump` | `[ENV-VALUE-…]` | The value on each NAME=value line of env, mise env or a .env file | when it reads as a name |
| `named-secret-yaml` | `[SECRET-…]` | A YAML line `password: value`, to the end of the line, commas and quotes included | when it reads as a name |
| `named-secret-yaml-block` | `[SECRET-…]` | A YAML block scalar under a name that says secret: `password: \|` and the indented lines after it |  |
| `named-value` | `[SECRET-…]` | The value of a {"name": …, "value": …} pair whose name says secret: ACR passwords, Kubernetes env lists |  |

## Allowed values

These exact values are left alone even when a rule above would hide them: they are settings or public names, not secrets. Only the value itself is allowed, never what sits next to it.

`true`, `false`, `development`, `production`, `staging`, `localhost`, `debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `Bearer`
